---
title: 'Appendix B — Carry-over test (Tables B.1, B.2)'
format: html
---

```{r}
pacman::p_load(tidyverse, arrow, here, fect)

data <- read_parquet(here("data", "data_quarterly.parquet"))
```

## Table B.1: exit event study, s = 3

```{r}
carry_3 <- fect(
  n_installations_per_1000 ~ treatment,
  data = data,
  index = c("MunicipalityCode", "time"),
  method = "fe",
  force = "two-way",
  se = TRUE,
  nboots = 1000,
  parallel = TRUE,
  seed = 42,
  carryoverTest = TRUE,
  carryover.period = c(1, 3)
)
carry_3$est.att.off[as.character(-6:7), c("ATT.OFF", "S.E.", "p.value", "count.off")]
```

## Table B.2

Each chunk prints one row of Table B.2: s, ATT carry-over, SE, 95% CI, p-value of H0: ATT carry-over = 0, TOST p-value.

### s = 2

```{r}
carry_2 <- fect(
  n_installations_per_1000 ~ treatment,
  data = data,
  index = c("MunicipalityCode", "time"),
  method = "fe",
  force = "two-way",
  se = TRUE,
  nboots = 1000,
  parallel = TRUE,
  seed = 42,
  carryoverTest = TRUE,
  carryover.period = c(1, 2)
)
c(
  s = 2,
  carry_2$est.carryover[1, c("ATT.carryover", "S.E.", "CI.lower", "CI.upper", "p.value")],
  tost_p = carry_2$test.out$carryover.equiv.p
)
```

### s = 3 (model estimated above)

```{r}
c(
  s = 3,
  carry_3$est.carryover[1, c("ATT.carryover", "S.E.", "CI.lower", "CI.upper", "p.value")],
  tost_p = carry_3$test.out$carryover.equiv.p
)
```
